::: {#def-ss-between}
#### Between-group sum of squares

Let $y_{j1}, \ldots, y_{jn_j}$ be the $n_j$ observations in group $j$,
for $k \ge 2$ groups with $n \eqdef \sumto{j}{k} n_j$ observations in all,
let $\outbar_j$ be the sample mean of group $j$,
and let $\outbar$ be the sample mean of all $n$ observations.
The **between-group sum of squares** is

$$\text{SS}_\text{between} \eqdef \sumto{j}{k} n_j (\outbar_j - \outbar)^2.$$

Source: @wikipedia_partition_of_sums_of_squares.
:::
